code_scope.resolution_error: Property refers to execution-layer Merkle Patricia Trie operations (trie_set, trie_get) from Osaka Fork specification. Prysm is a consensus-layer client that does not implement execution-layer state trie operations. These are handled by execution clients like Geth or Besu. Searched: trie_set, TrieSet, trie_get, TrieGet, MerklePatricia, patricia - no matches found in consensus-layer codebase. The only trie implementations found were FieldTrie (beacon state tries) and TrieLayer (PoW chain) which are unrelated to execution-layer state management.
